investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Tappine Labs (collaboration SaaS); Platform: Microsoft Azure uksouth (zones uksouth-1/uksouth-2/uksouth-3); network range 10.220.0.0/16; External dependency: sms-notifier calls a SMS gateway (sms.relaycast.net) protected by a circuit breaker; external synthetic probes monitor public dependencies; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
